name: Unclean Spirits
overview: The Scriptures reveal that unclean spirits are demonic forces that possess individuals, causing distress and sickness, as seen when Jesus cast them out and healed all who were afflicted (Matthew 8:16). Jesus granted His disciples authority to confront and expel these spirits, demonstrating His sovereign power over them (Matthew 10:1). These spirits recognize Jesus’ divine identity, falling before Him and declaring Him the Son of God (Mark 3:11), yet they remain restless when cast out, seeking a place to dwell without finding rest (Matthew 12:43). The presence of unclean spirits is a reality confronted by Christ and His followers, underscoring the spiritual battle inherent in the gospel message.
